tail:
**A8 status — adjudication complete, repairs applied and gated, certification in flight.**

I recovered the wave state from disk first: A6 closed green (`depcheck` exit 0, zero `published-unaudited`), A7 complete with **182 verdicts over 91 items, zero nulls** — DeepSeek 4 rejections, Sonnet 5 ten. No adjudication existed; A8 had not started.

Because 10 of the 14 rejections are Sonnet's and I am `claude-opus-5` — same family, as `CLAUDE.md` warns — I did not adjudicate on my own reading. Each rejection got an independent **GPT 5.6 Sol** read-only lane, cross-family to both the judge and me. All 14 returned. I agreed with the lane on 13 of 14.

**Adjudication: 5 confirmed fatal, 6 confirmed nonfatal, 3 false positives.**

| verdict | items |
|---|---|
| **fatal** | `def-cofinality` (cites two targets for "infinite cardinal"; neither defines it) · `lem-successor-cardinal-exists` (Remark falsely says the cardinal successor is *always* written ℵ(κ) on a page whose sibling defines κ⁺ for it) · `thm-locally-compact-hausdorff-basics` (Remark credits claim 4 to the one-point compactification, which uses claim 1 — claim 4 is cited by no item in the corpus) · `ex-compactness-in-the-standard-topologies` ("every theorem … carries a Hausdorff hypothesis" — Tychonoff, FIP, continuous images and extreme values all refute it on the very page named) · `ex-the-alexander-…` ([L4] takes totality of ℝ from `def-real-order`, which expressly defers trichotomy elsewhere) |
| **nonfatal** | 6, closed on their ledger rows with no edit |
| **false positive** | `thm-tarski-square`, `thm-closed-subspace-…` (DeepSeek reversed the page order), `cex-limit-point-compact-…` |

Two Sonnet rows recorded `reject` while their own reason text concluded *keep* — the verdict-extraction failure `CLAUDE.md` documents. Precision this wave: **DeepSeek 3/4, Sonnet 8/10**; no item was rejected by both lanes.

Applied only the five fatal repairs. `step8-guard` against `pre-a8`: **5 changed, 5/5 licensed**. `precheck`, `proof-contract --strict` (77/77 after I updated ten stale contract quotes my `def-cofinality` edit invalidated), `finite-smoke`, and all six link/prose gates are green; `impact-audit` receipt validates at 5 interfaces / 39 dispositions.

Two things worth flagging now rather than at the end:

- **My own lanes found three fatal-grade defects the judges did not name** — including the same "infinite cardinal" miscitation a third time, in `ex-an-aleph-fixed-point` [L8]. R1 is fatal-only and only a judge rejection licenses an edit, so I have **not** repaired them. They go to A10 as evidenced open defects, and they are direct evidence for the policy question of whether A8 should stay fatal-only when its refuters outrun its judges.
- I took one stage-level `post-a8` snapshot, because `impact-audit` compares two snapshots and computed `changed: 0` against `pre-a8` itself. No per-item snapshots; the ledger's "51 repaired more than once" remains the known artefact of the Betas' 22 per-item snapshots.

Five independent Sol certifiers are reading the final text now. The stale `verification.verified` stamps are removed until they report — `depcheck` is red on exactly those five, which is the gate working. On CERTIFY I write the stamps, run the targeted paired rejudge (prerequisites verified available in this shell), and close A8.
